bio.text: Jeff Ehlers is a Republican who represents District 21 (Seat B) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a second term, with Meridian as Ehlers's listed residence.
The legislature's biography describes Ehlers as a sixth-generation Idahoan and a graduate of Shelley High School.
Ehlers holds bachelor's and master's degrees in accounting from BYU-Provo and an MBA from the University of Utah, and is a CPA and small business owner.
